messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up: BeaconCo returned our MSA/DPA with redlines. They say they'll issue a PO before Order Form countersign. Asks: Net45, PO must reference OF#, expanded auditor access, and an HSM clause. POC stuck until PO.

olivia_ops: Can we start provisioning on PO-only? Need to know guardrails if MSA not signed.

nate_fin: Finance can accept PO as trigger but require either PO references OF and billing entity + tax id, or prepay / trial credit cap while MSA unsigned. Net45 only after entity validation.

reza_legal: I reviewed redlines. Don't accept broad auditor rights. I propose a "Provisional Access Addendum": 30-day term, scoped audit extracts via portal only, limited liability for POC, and Exhibit A ops checklist. I can draft it today.

maya_sec: Security note: we have SOC2 Type II summary. No public HSM attestation today. For POC we can offer KMS placeholder and strict retention/export rules: retention 14d, exports disabled, no key exports. HSM on Private deployment but that is 2-3w.

jordan_se: Ops can provision a dedicated sandbox with those controls. ETA 4 business days after PO + billing contact + addendum ack. Performance caveat: HSM integration adds latency; POC works with KMS placeholder. Suggested runtime config for POC: `batch_size:12`, `cache:prefix`, `token_retention:14d`.

sam_sales: Customer says PO will be sent today and will reference OF-2026-777. They're willing to sign the Provisional Addendum.

nate_fin: Ask customer to attach PO PDF to billing@redwood.com with billing contact and tax/VAT. We'll validate and map to invoice flow.

reza_legal: Action items: I will upload Provisional Addendum + Exhibit A by EOD. If customer pushes broader audit rights we escalate to GC.

maya_sec: I'll attach SOC2 summary and a short HSM roadmap note in the thread.

jordan_se: Infra tentatively has a slot next Tue. Ops will lock it once PO + billing + addendum ack are in.

sam_sales: Uploaded customer's PO sample snippet: "PO# BC-2026-441, Net45, Bill to Redwood Inference, Inc, Ref: OF-2026-777". Will post PDF when it arrives.

olivia_ops: Once PO PDF lands, ops needs a signed ack or email confirmation accepting the Provisional Addendum terms to proceed.

sam_sales: Will push for PDF + billing contact now. If anything blocks escalation will loop in exec sponsor. :thumbsup:
